visual_scope: Limited visual review of eight highlighted series. The images show actual series products, not a guarantee of the random design in one blind box. This is not a visual audit of the full catalog. Two ordinary Nommi crossbody bags were separately identified as non-toy merchandise and excluded from toy counts.

photo_exclusions.reason: The available photograph shows a general store display, not a clearly verified A Piece of Cake six-slice product. Keep launch research as a source lead until a matching product photograph is verified.

TOP TOY's product title and ONE BAG option identify a Nommi x Disney 101 Dalmatians crossbody bag, not a blind-box figure or squishy. The product photograph shows a functional handbag. Preserve as related IP merchandise outside toy and trend counts.

TOP TOY's product title and ONE BAG option identify a Nommi x Disney Marie crossbody bag, not a blind-box figure or squishy. Preserve as related IP merchandise outside toy and trend counts; do not treat ordinary bag offers as random figure boxes.
